src4.text:
The society keeps its cars at two sites, Stonecross Museum Hall and Canal Wharf Depot.

Fleet TVT-004, livery name Bluebell, runs on 750 mm gauge and was built on 1931-12-03. Its recorded withdrawal reason is "Replaced by diesel bus fleet." Fleet TVT-031, livery name Copper Lady, runs on 880 mm gauge and was built on 1937-10-18. No withdrawal reason is recorded, so it is still in service. Fleet TVT-042, livery name Old Ironsides, runs on 1220 mm gauge and was built on 1909-11-21. Its recorded withdrawal reason is "Stored pending overhaul funds." Fleet TVT-002, livery name Quayside, runs on 950 mm gauge. No build date is recorded, and no withdrawal reason is recorded, so it is still in service.

A restoration job titled "Rewire headlight circuit, car 22" was carried out on Copper Lady, at a cost of 512300 minor units in EUR.

Quayside is home at Brackley Road Car Shed in the role of home, valid from 2025-06-30 until 2025-11-15. Copper Lady is home at Stonecross Museum Hall in the role of home, valid from 2024-03-04, with no end date recorded. Saltmarsh is home at Brackley Road Car Shed in the role of home, valid from 2024-11-02, with no end date recorded.

Margaret Okonjo-Hale is approved to crew Quayside from 2025-01-10, with no end date recorded. Rhys Tallentire is approved to crew Bluebell from 2025-12-12; this replaces an earlier statement about the same record, and only the tram changed. Dafydd Penrose is approved to crew Bluebell from 2024-06-15. Rhys Tallentire is certified to crew Bluebell from 2024-06-15. Rhys Tallentire is certified to crew Saltmarsh from 2024-09-01.

Saltmarsh was inspected on 2024-06-18. Rhys Tallentire was the inspector, Margaret Okonjo-Hale was the assessor, and the verdict was fail.

Margaret Okonjo-Hale is authorised to drive Bluebell from 2023-02-27, with no end date recorded. Margaret Okonjo-Hale is licensed to drive Bluebell from 2021-09-03. Dafydd Penrose is licensed to drive Brighton Belle from 2021-09-03. Dafydd Penrose is authorised to drive Harbour Cream from 2022-11-05.
